title: PROPOSED MONUMENT: ETTA JAMES RESIDENCE
text:
PROPOSED MONUMENT: ETTA JAMES RESIDENCE

  CHC-2026-5343-HCM
  CEQA: ENV-2026-5344-CE  Council District: 15 – McOsker
  Plan Area: Harbor Gateway  Last Day to Act: 11-13-26

  PROPERTY ADDRESS:  642 West Athens Boulevard

  REQUESTED ACTIONS:
  Review of the Historic-Cultural Monument application, pursuant to Los Angeles Administrative Code
  Section 22.171.10, to determine whether to take the proposed designation of a Monument under
  consideration.

  Owner:  Mark Brooker

  Applicant:  Christina Morris, National Trust for Historic Preservation
  Preparer:  Adam Rajper, Historic Resources Group
summary: The Cultural Heritage Commission will decide whether to take up a proposed monument designation for the Etta James Residence at 642 West Athens Boulevard in Harbor Gateway.
